content.rendered:
Positive Sorting—a revolutionary concept that redefines the MRF system.

Positive Sorting, a revolutionary concept that redefines the MRF system, involves targeting paper early on in the system so as to separate it quickly and cleanly. View the video to see how we achieve the cleanest possible paper grades with our Next-Gen MRF.
